payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is there any visible progress toward making the image look like a comic-book photo?
node.criteria: Pass if the edited image shows a discernible change toward comic-book styling while retaining photographic subject matter, even if the requested combination is incomplete. Fail if no requested change is visible. Unknown if the image or relevant changes cannot be assessed.
node.binding: Assess only visible progress toward the requested comic-book photo appearance; unrelated edits do not count.

response.content: {"status":"fail","evidence":"The edited image retains the same photographic street scene, with no discernible comic-book styling; visible differences appear limited to framing or minor image adjustments.","confidence":0.91,"used_dependency_ids":[]}
